string.text: Beasts at the South Gate

This is no migration but a full surge: large dog and pseudodog packs, snorks, bloodsuckers, chimeras and pseudogiants. Reach the southern checkpoint, wait for the signal and hold until the last creature is dead.
Reach Rostok's southern checkpoint and repel six escalating mutant waves.
The southern approach is secure again.
Breakthrough at the Barrier

Six Monolith assault groups broke through the Barrier and are pushing toward Rostok from Army Warehouses. They include exoskeleton troops and RPG operators. Take position at the northern checkpoint, wait for contact and hold the line.
Reach Rostok's northern checkpoint and destroy all six Monolith assault groups.
None of them reached the Bar. The line held.
Raid on Rostok
The bandits have assembled six heavy assault groups to break Rostok's southern checkpoint. Take position outside the gate and hold until the raid collapses.
Reach Rostok's southern checkpoint and repel six bandit assault groups.
The raid died at the gate.
The monochromes are about to emerge near the checkpoint. Everyone, take your positions!
Their second line is moving. RPGs and heavy infantry - keep your heads down!
The northern line was abandoned. The operation has failed.
Take position at Rostok's northern checkpoint.
Hold the northern checkpoint and destroy all six groups.
The pack is reaching the road. Contact in seconds - hold the gate!
That was only the first mass. Bloodsuckers and heavy mutants are coming!
The southern checkpoint was abandoned. The packs broke through to Rostok.
Take position at Rostok's southern checkpoint.
Hold the southern checkpoint until all six waves are destroyed.
Raiders on the road. Everyone take cover - here they come!
Their reserve is moving up. More heavy groups are coming for the gate!
The southern line was abandoned. The raiders broke through to Rostok.
Take position at Rostok's southern checkpoint.
Hold the southern checkpoint and destroy all six groups.
